sketch:
2. Mental fatigue
As aforementioned, mental fatigue is another condition which entitles receipt of a nursing beneft (in any event, the insured will be entitled to benefts in respect of only one entitling condition). The determination of mental fatigue will only be made by a specialist in the feld, i.e. a specialist in geriatrics, psychiatry, psychogeriatric specialist and/or neurologist.
For the purpose of this decision, the specialist physician will examine, inter alia, the history of the disease, general impression, medical follow up, and medicinal treatment.

טבלה: טיפול סיעודי - קריטריונים
This table outlines the criteria for receiving nursing benefits under the Clalit Mushlam Nursing policy, specifically focusing on conditions like mental fatigue. It details the specialist assessments required to determine eligibility for benefits.
ממדים: Entitling conditions for nursing benefits, Details of the condition and assessment process

2. Mental fatigue
As aforementioned, mental fatigue is another condition which entitles receipt of a nursing beneft (in any event, the insured will be entitled to benefts in respect of only one entitling condition). The determination of mental fatigue will only be made by a specialist in the feld, i.e. a specialist in geriatrics, psychiatry, psychogeriatric specialist and/or neurologist.
For the purpose of this decision, the specialist physician will examine, inter alia, the history of the disease, general impression, medical follow up, and medicinal treatment.
